v5-14.candidate: but the seventh day is a Sabbath unto the Lord your God. You shall do no work therein, you, nor your sons, nor your daughter, nor your male slave, nor your female slave, nor your ox, nor your beast of burden, nor any of your livestock, nor the sojourner dwelling with you; that your male slave and your female slave may rest as you do.

v5-21.candidate: You shall not covet your neighbour’s wife. You shall not covet your neighbour’s house, nor his field, nor his male slave, nor his female slave, nor his ox, nor his beast of burden, nor any of his livestock, nor anything that is your neighbour’s.

v7-14.candidate: You shall be blessed above all the nations; there shall be no barren male or female among you, nor among your livestock.

v7-25.candidate: You shall burn the graven images of their gods with fire. You shall not covet the silver or gold from them, nor take it unto yourself, lest you stumble thereby; for it is an abomination unto the Lord your God.
